niche.habitat: Hollowed moon-sized asteroid arks at 30–100 AU, featuring a warm pressurized core, mid-tier agricultural rings, and a cryogenic rim under 1.2 bar N₂/O₂.
niche.diet: Closed-loop recycled biomass, fungal/algae cultures, and chemoautotrophic supplements filtered through engineered cell mats.
niche.active: Continuous; circadian rhythms dampened by artificial lighting and forced atmospheric circulation.

body: Elongated, spindly limbs and reinforced joint valves prevent cephalad fluid pooling in microgravity, while a pressurized circulatory system maintains hemodynamic stability without hydrostatic gradients. Their modified cloacal vents expel dense atmospheric mass to generate three-dimensional thrust, turning the entire hollow asteroid into a navigable fluid.

chains.trait: Spindly, elongated limbs with reinforced joint valves
links: Absence of compressive loading permits extreme skeletal elongation and low density
Microgravity eliminates hydrostatic gradients, causing cephalad fluid shift and upper-body congestion
Hollow moon-sized arks at 30–100 AU lack planetary mass to anchor biology

skill.effect: The creature strongly expels air from its joints, shoving nearby allies or enemies away and leaving behind vacuum pockets that disrupt movement for a short while.

chains.weakness: Sudden atmospheric depressurization depletes thruster reaction mass, leaving them drifting and vulnerable for 2 turns.
observe: See them floating effortlessly, limbs splayed like underwater dancers
Joint valves pulse rhythmically with recirculated hemolymph
Air jets shimmer in the still, forced-circulation atmosphere

journal.en: They don't walk the void; they breathe it.

plausibility.summary: Rename joint 'valves' to venous/lymphatic one-way check valves and dependent muscle pumps (human postural physiology, not hemolymph); treat Aerodynamic Drift as a brief pressure pulse or eddy in forced-circulation airflow, not literal vacuum pockets that would breach closed-loop O2 budgets (F8, F9).
fixes: Rename joint 'valves' to venous/lymphatic one-way check valves and dependent muscle pumps (human postural physiology, not hemolymph); treat Aerodynamic Drift as a brief pressure pulse or eddy in forced-circulation airflow, not literal vacuum pockets that would breach closed-loop O2 budgets (F8, F9).

analogues.organism: ISS crew osteopenia and disproportionate limb use in microgravity (mechanism: disuse atrophy, cephalad fluid shift); ostrich long legs show extreme elongation under loading but inverse logic applies when loading is absent.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Jet-propelled cloacal vents with elongated limbs
links: Modified sphincter expels atmospheric mass for 3D thrust
Newton's third law requires dense reaction medium for vector control
1.2 bar N₂/O₂ atmosphere provides optimal thrust density
Microgravity shell geometry eliminates compressive loading, permitting zero-inertia locomotion

skill.effect: The creature strongly releases a burst of air from its vents, propelling itself swiftly in the chosen direction and displacing the surrounding atmosphere.

chains.weakness: Rapid pressure depletion causes hypoxia and drift in adjacent arks

journal.en: They fly by coughing the sky.

plausibility.summary: Keep thrust as short vectored bursts with immediate recharge via ark fans (F8); cap expelled volume so local ΔP stays under hypoxia threshold; locomotion is lore-given engineering plus selection for sphincter and pelvic-floor robustness, not a naturally evolved primary gait.

analogues.organism: Cephalopod mantle jet propulsion (water as reaction mass); parallels are locomotor mode not homologous anatomy.

relations.note: Both stretch limbs and reinforce joints to dance through microgravity. Spacers jet; Amphicephali grip. Convergent elegance. -> Skill: 'Micro-g precision' (Engage)

Spacers' jet-vent locomotion establishes foundational 3D vector thrust. Asteromorphs inherit and scale this into structural ark-building and sail-brain deployment, passing the skill across generations. -> Skill: 'Vector thrust inheritance' (Basic)

temperament: Detached and diasporic, they view planetary gravity as a biological trap and prefer the silent, boundless architecture of the void.
secrets: Can temporarily seal cloacal vents to create localized pressure vacuums, disorienting pursuers or conserving oxygen during long transits.
moments: Drifting through the warm core’s agricultural rings, they use precise air-jets to harvest floating spore-balloons, their elongated fingers brushing against forced-circulation fans that keep the atmosphere from stratifying.
